prompt.en: Style the `.box` element in styles.css: background color `rgb(255, 0, 0)` (red), width `200px`, height `100px`. The preview shows the box — after your styles it must be a red 200×100 square. Make the tests green.
prompt.ru: Стилизуи `.box` в styles.css: цвет фона `rgb(255, 0, 0)` (красный), ширина `200px`, высота `100px`. В превью виден блок — после стилей он должен стать красным квадратом 200×100. Сделай тесты зелёными.

tests.name: red background
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.box')); assert(s.backgroundColor === 'rgb(255, 0, 0)', "expected rgb(255, 0, 0), got " + s.backgroundColor);

tests.name: 200x100
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.box')); assert(s.width === '200px' && s.height === '100px', "expected 200px x 100px, got " + s.width + " x " + s.height);

hint.en: A simple rule: `.box { background: …; width: …; height: …; }`.

prompt.en: Apply to `.box`: `padding: 20px` and `margin: 40px`. Then, in the test expectations: the element's content-box padding must be 20px on all sides and margin 40px. Do not touch the element's width/height.
prompt.ru: Примени к `.box`: `padding: 20px` и `margin: 40px`. В элементах должны быть внутренние отступы 20px со всех сторон и внешние 40px. Ширина/высоту не трогай.

tests.name: padding 20px
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.box')); assert(s.paddingTop === '20px' && s.paddingRight === '20px' && s.paddingBottom === '20px' && s.paddingLeft === '20px', "expected 20px padding on all sides");

tests.name: margin 40px
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.box')); assert(s.marginTop === '40px' && s.marginRight === '40px' && s.marginBottom === '40px' && s.marginLeft === '40px', "expected 40px margin on all sides");

hint.en: padding — внутри рамки (между контентом и бордером), margin — снаружи (между элементами).
hint.ru: padding — внутри рамки (между контентом и бордером), margin — снаружи (между элементами).

prompt.en: Style the `h1` on the page: `font-size: 32px`, `font-weight: 700`, `color: rgb(17, 24, 39)` (near-black), `text-align: center`. And the paragraphs: `font-size: 16px`, `line-height: 1.6`.
prompt.ru: Стилизуи `h1` на странице: `font-size: 32px`, `font-weight: 700`, `color: rgb(17, 24, 39)` (почти чёрный), `text-align: center`. И параграфы: `font-size: 16px`, `line-height: 1.6`.

files.index.html:
Hello, typography

Paragraph with some text to measure line height and size.

tests.name: h1 styles
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('h1')); assert(s.fontSize === '32px' && s.fontWeight === '700' && s.color === 'rgb(17, 24, 39)' && s.textAlign === 'center', "check h1: got " + s.fontSize + " / " + s.fontWeight + " / " + s.color + " / " + s.textAlign);

tests.name: p styles
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('p')); assert(s.fontSize === '16px' && s.lineHeight === '25.6px', "expected 16px font and line-height 1.6 (= 25.6px), got " + s.fontSize + " / " + s.lineHeight);

hint.en: line-height: 1.6 is a unitless multiplier: for a 16px font the browser computes 25.6px.
hint.ru: line-height: 1.6 — безразмерный множитель: для шрифта 16px браузер считает 25.6px.

prompt.en: Give `.card` a modern look: `border-radius: 12px`, `border: 1px solid rgb(229, 231, 235)`, `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)`, `padding: 24px`. All four properties are checked by tests.
prompt.ru: Сделай `.card` в современном стиле: `border-radius: 12px`, `border: 1px solid rgb(229, 231, 235)`, `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)`, `padding: 24px`. Все четыре свойства проверяются тестами.

tests.name: radius and padding
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.card')); assert(s.borderRadius === '12px' && s.padding === '24px', "expected radius 12px + padding 24px, got " + s.borderRadius + " / " + s.padding);

tests.name: border
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.card')); assert(s.borderTopWidth === '1px' && s.borderTopColor === 'rgb(229, 231, 235)' && s.borderTopStyle === 'solid', "expected 1px solid rgb(229,231,235)");

tests.name: shadow
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.card')); assert(/0px 4px 12px/.test(s.boxShadow) && s.boxShadow !== 'none', "expected shadow 0 4px 12px, got " + s.boxShadow);

hint.en: box-shadow: offset-x offset-y blur color — the color can be rgba or rgb(... / 0.08).
hint.ru: box-shadow: offset-x offset-y blur цвет — цвет можно rgba или rgb(... / 0.08).

prompt.en: Make `.row` a flex container: items in one horizontal row, centered on both axes (`justify-content: center` + `align-items: center`), with `gap: 12px` between items and `height: 120px`. The three child `.item` divs must sit in the middle of the row.
prompt.ru: Сделай `.row` flex-контейнером: элементы в один горизонтальный ряд, по центру по обеим осям (`justify-content: center` + `align-items: center`), `gap: 12px` между элементами, `height: 120px`. Три дочерних div `.item` должны оказаться посередине ряда.

files.index.html:
1
2
3

tests.name: flex center
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.row')); assert(s.display === 'flex' && s.justifyContent === 'center' && s.alignItems === 'center', "expected display:flex + center/center, got " + s.display + " / " + s.justifyContent + " / " + s.alignItems);

tests.name: gap 12px
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.row')); assert(s.gap === '12px' || s.columnGap === '12px', "expected gap 12px, got " + s.gap);

tests.name: single row
tests.code: const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.item')].map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect().top); assert(new Set(items).size === 1, "items must be on one horizontal line");

tests.name: vertically centered
tests.code: const row = document.querySelector('.row').getBoundingClientRect(); const item = document.querySelector('.item').getBoundingClientRect(); const diff = Math.abs((row.top + row.height / 2) - (item.top + item.height / 2)); assert(diff < 2, "item must be vertically centered, offset " + diff + "px");

hint.en: display: flex + justify-content (main axis) + align-items (cross axis).

prompt.en: Turn `.toolbar` into a flex row: `justify-content: space-between`, `align-items: center`, `padding: 8px 16px`. The first child (`.logo`) must sit at the left edge, the last (`.actions`) at the right edge, with the middle item between them.
prompt.ru: Преврати `.toolbar` в flex-ряд: `justify-content: space-between`, `align-items: center`, `padding: 8px 16px`. Первый элемент (`.logo`) — у левого края, последний (`.actions`) — у правого, средний — между ними.

files.index.html: Logo Middle Actions

tests.name: flex space-between
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.toolbar')); assert(s.display === 'flex' && s.justifyContent === 'space-between' && s.alignItems === 'center', "expected flex space-between center");

tests.name: padding
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.toolbar')); assert(s.paddingTop === '8px' && s.paddingLeft === '16px', "expected padding 8px 16px");

tests.name: logo at left edge
tests.code: const tb = document.querySelector('.toolbar').getBoundingClientRect(); const logo = document.querySelector('.logo').getBoundingClientRect(); assert(logo.left - tb.left < 20, "logo must be near the left padding edge, offset " + (logo.left - tb.left) + "px");

tests.name: actions at right edge
tests.code: const tb = document.querySelector('.toolbar').getBoundingClientRect(); const act = document.querySelector('.actions').getBoundingClientRect(); assert(tb.right - act.right < 20, "actions must be near the right padding edge, offset " + (tb.right - act.right) + "px");

hint.en: space-between: first and last items on the edges, the rest evenly in between.
hint.ru: space-between: первый и последний элементы у краёв, остальные равномерно между ними.

prompt.en: Make `.grid` a CSS Grid with three equal columns and `gap: 16px`: use `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)`. The six `.cell` children must be laid out in two rows of three.
prompt.ru: Сделай `.grid` CSS Grid с тремя равными колонками и `gap: 16px`: используй `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)`. Шесть детей `.cell` должны встать в два ряда по три.

files.index.html:
1
2
3
4
5
6

tests.name: grid template
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.grid')); assert(s.display === 'grid', "expected display:grid"); assert(/repeat\(3, 1fr\)|1fr 1fr 1fr/.test(s.gridTemplateColumns) || s.gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').filter(Boolean).length === 3, "expected 3 columns, got " + s.gridTemplateColumns);

tests.name: gap 16px
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.grid')); assert(s.gap === '16px' || s.columnGap === '16px', "expected gap 16px, got " + s.gap);

tests.name: 2 rows of 3
tests.code: const cells = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cell')].map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect()); const row1 = new Set([0, 1, 2].map((i) => Math.round(cells[i].top / 10))); const row2 = new Set([3, 4, 5].map((i) => Math.round(cells[i].top / 10))); assert(row1.size === 1 && row2.size === 1 && cells[0].top < cells[3].top, "expected two rows of three cells");

hint.en: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) — three columns, each takes an equal fraction of the width.
hint.ru: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) — три колонки, каждая берёт равную долю ширины.

prompt.en: Typography for reading: `p` gets `font-size: 18px`, `line-height: 1.7`, `max-width: 640px`, `margin-left: auto`, `margin-right: auto` (a centered column); `h2` gets `letter-spacing: -0.02em` and `font-weight: 800`. The tests read the computed styles.
prompt.ru: Типографика для чтения: `p` получает `font-size: 18px`, `line-height: 1.7`, `max-width: 640px`, `margin-left: auto`, `margin-right: auto` (центрированная колонка); `h2` — `letter-spacing: -0.02em` и `font-weight: 800`. Тесты читают вычисленные стили.

files.index.html:
Long-form article

This paragraph is intentionally long so that the max-width constraint becomes visible in the preview: text that flows into a narrow centered column is much easier to read than a wall of text spanning the whole window. Keep your eyes on the line length.

tests.name: p typography
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('p')); assert(s.fontSize === '18px' && s.lineHeight === '30.6px' && s.maxWidth === '640px', "expected 18px / 1.7 (=30.6px) / max-width 640px, got " + s.fontSize + " / " + s.lineHeight + " / " + s.maxWidth);

tests.name: p centered
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('p')); assert(s.marginLeft === 'auto' && s.marginRight === 'auto', "expected margin auto on both sides");

tests.name: h2
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('h2')); assert(s.fontWeight === '800' && s.letterSpacing === '-0.27px' || s.letterSpacing === '-0.3px' || s.letterSpacing === '-0.28px', "expected letter-spacing -0.02em (≈ -0.27px), got " + s.letterSpacing);

hint.en: Center a block of a given max-width with margin: 0 auto. -0.02em ≈ -0.27px at 13.5px… the test accepts rounding.
hint.ru: Блок с max-width центрируется margin: 0 auto. -0.02em ≈ -0.27px… тест допускает округление.

prompt.en: Define `@keyframes pulse` (scale from 1 to 1.1 and back: `50% { transform: scale(1.1) }`), and apply it to `.dot`: `animation: pulse 1s infinite`. The computed style of `.dot` must show the animation name, duration 1s, and iteration count infinite.
prompt.ru: Определи `@keyframes pulse` (масштаб от 1 к 1.1 и обратно: `50% { transform: scale(1.1) }`) и примени к `.dot`: `animation: pulse 1s infinite`. Вычисленный стиль `.dot` должен показывать имя анимации, длительность 1s и повторение infinite.

tests.name: animation properties
keyframes exist
tests.code: let found = false; for (const sheet of document.styleSheets) { for (const rule of sheet.cssRules || []) { if (rule.type === 7 && rule.name === 'pulse') found = true; } } assert(found, "expected @keyframes pulse in the styles");

hint.en: Shorthand: animation: <name> <duration> <iteration-count>. The 50% keyframe is where the scale peaks.
hint.ru: Сокращённо: animation: <имя> <длительность> <повторы>. В keyframe 50% — пик масштаба.

prompt.en: Build a hover effect for `.lift`: base state — `transform: translateY(0)`, `box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)`, `transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease`. On `:hover` — `transform: translateY(-8px)` and a bigger shadow (`0 12px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15)`). The test reads the base computed style (transition + transform).
prompt.ru: Сделай hover-эффект для `.lift`: базовое состояние — `transform: translateY(0)`, `box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)`, `transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease`. При `:hover` — `transform: translateY(-8px)` и большая тень (`0 12px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15)`). Тест читает базовый вычисленный стиль (transition + transform).

tests.name: transition declared
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.lift')); assert(s.transitionProperty.includes('transform') && s.transitionProperty.includes('box-shadow') && s.transitionDuration.includes('0.3s'), "expected transition transform+box-shadow 0.3s, got " + s.transitionProperty + " / " + s.transitionDuration);

tests.name: base transform is identity
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.lift')); assert(s.transform === 'none' || s.transform === 'matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)', "expected no displacement in base state, got " + s.transform);

tests.name: hover rule exists
tests.code: let found = false; for (const sheet of document.styleSheets) { for (const rule of sheet.cssRules || []) { if (rule.selectorText && rule.selectorText.includes('.lift:hover')) { found = /translateY\(-8px\)/.test(rule.cssText); } } } assert(found, "expected .lift:hover with translateY(-8px)");

hint.en: Transition animates between the base state and the :hover state — declare it on the base rule, not on :hover.
hint.ru: Transition анимирует переход между базовым и :hover — объявляется в базовом правиле, не в :hover.

prompt.en: Build a page layout with Grid named areas. `.layout`: `display: grid`, `grid-template-areas: "header header" "sidebar main" "footer footer"`, `grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr`, `gap: 12px`. Assign each child its area: `.layout-header { grid-area: header }`, `.layout-sidebar { grid-area: sidebar }`, `.layout-main { grid-area: main }`, `.layout-footer { grid-area: footer }`.
prompt.ru: Сделай раскладку страницы на Grid с именованными областями. `.layout`: `display: grid`, `grid-template-areas: "header header" "sidebar main" "footer footer"`, `grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr`, `gap: 12px`. Каждому ребёнку — его область: `.layout-header { grid-area: header }`, `.layout-sidebar { grid-area: sidebar }`, `.layout-main { grid-area: main }`, `.layout-footer { grid-area: footer }`.

files.index.html:
Header
Sidebar
Main
Footer

tests.name: template areas
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.layout')); assert(s.display === 'grid', "expected display:grid"); assert(/header/.test(s.gridTemplateAreas) && /sidebar/.test(s.gridTemplateAreas) && /main/.test(s.gridTemplateAreas), "expected named areas, got: " + s.gridTemplateAreas);

tests.name: columns 200px 1fr
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.layout')); const cols = s.gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').filter(Boolean); assert(cols.length === 2 && cols[0] === '200px', "expected 200px + 1fr columns, got " + s.gridTemplateColumns);

tests.name: areas assigned
tests.code: const gs = (c) => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(c)).gridArea; assert(gs('.layout-header') === 'header' && gs('.layout-sidebar') === 'sidebar' && gs('.layout-main') === 'main' && gs('.layout-footer') === 'footer', "each block must have its grid-area, got: " + ['.layout-header', '.layout-sidebar', '.layout-main', '.layout-footer'].map(gs).join(','));

tests.name: header spans full width
tests.code: const hdr = document.querySelector('.layout-header').getBoundingClientRect(); const side = document.querySelector('.layout-sidebar').getBoundingClientRect(); const main = document.querySelector('.layout-main').getBoundingClientRect(); assert(hdr.width >= side.width + main.width - 2, "header must span both columns");

hint.en: grid-template-areas is a mini-map: each string is a row. Child: grid-area: <name>.
hint.ru: grid-template-areas — миникарта: каждая строка — ряд. У ребёнка: grid-area: <имя>.

title.en: Card Stack with Gap and Wrap

prompt.en: Create a responsive card stack: `.stack` — `display: flex`, `flex-wrap: wrap`, `gap: 16px`, `justify-content: flex-start`; each `.card-in-stack` — `flex: 1 1 160px` (can grow, basis 160px) and `max-width: 220px`. All five cards must be visible (they wrap onto multiple lines).
prompt.ru: Сделай адаптивную стопку карточек: `.stack` — `display: flex`, `flex-wrap: wrap`, `gap: 16px`, `justify-content: flex-start`; каждая `.card-in-stack` — `flex: 1 1 160px` (может расти, basis 160px) и `max-width: 220px`. Все пять карточек должны быть видны (переносятся на несколько строк).

B

tests.name: stack is wrapping flex
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.stack')); assert(s.display === 'flex' && s.flexWrap === 'wrap' && s.gap === '16px', "expected flex wrap gap 16px, got " + s.display + " / " + s.flexWrap + " / " + s.gap);

tests.name: card flex-basis
tests.code: const s = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.card-in-stack')); assert(s.flexBasis === '160px' && s.maxWidth === '220px', "expected flex-basis 160px + max-width 220px, got " + s.flexBasis + " / " + s.maxWidth);

tests.name: all cards laid out
tests.code: const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card-in-stack')]; assert(cards.length === 5 && cards.every((c) => c.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0 && c.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0), "all 5 cards must be visible");

tests.name: cards wrap
tests.code: const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card-in-stack')].map((c) => c.getBoundingClientRect().top); const rows = new Set(cards.map((t) => Math.round(t / 10))); assert(rows.size >= 2, "cards must wrap onto multiple lines");

hint.en: flex: 1 1 160px = grow 1, shrink 1, basis 160px — the card takes at least 160px and stretches to fill the row.
hint.ru: flex: 1 1 160px = grow 1, shrink 1, basis 160px — карточка берёт минимум 160px и растёт, заполняя ряд.
